critical_concerns.description: [PIT-C13/AX-002] The package claims C13 compliance because Z_Score_Aligned is untouched, but the delivered alpha is manually sign-inverted at composite level. C13 prohibits FLIP_SIGN, not only factor-column mutation.

[RF-A6/AX-002] DSR gate fails: alpha_diagnostics_final.rds has dsr_post_lo=-0.056 while the package hardcodes +0.056 and still misses the required DSR>=0.50. This is not a formal Bailey-Lopez de Prado DSR.
[AX-007/L-484] AX-007 exception is only promised, not evidenced. The package says single-sleeve top20 deployment is forbidden, but no paired multi-sleeve weights.csv or optimizer artifact exists.

[RF-A5] Liquidity feasibility is unresolved: the package admits top-decile post-flip names are illiquid/borderline and uses top70/5e7-style filtering rather than proving 20d TV>=2e8 for selected names.
[RF-A4/AX-002] Sector-neutral robustness is not measured. post_neutralization_ic is an estimate equal to 0.85*rank_ic, so RF-A4 cannot be cleared.

[AX-008/AX-002] challenge_note.md, risk_package, optimization_package, weights.csv, and covariance.parquet are absent for this task; artifact_lineage also has method_shopping_log_ref=null and references missing run_all.R.

supporting_arguments: alpha_scores.parquet in stage_artifacts/WT_D20260426_001 is genuinely time-series: 239 monthly sig_dates, 446137 rows, variable universe, and zero date-ticker duplicates.

C15 is mostly respected for factor loading because load_month_factors() is used for the selected factor matrix.
unresolved_disputes: Whether composite-level sign inversion can ever be allowed under PIT-C13; my position is no.
Whether load_month_factors() internally proves Usable_Date<=sig_date for L01/L11/L12/R13; no artifact exposes that audit.
Whether discovery request constraints supersede the base hard liquidity mandate of 20d TV>=2e8.
Whether the alpha works after actual optimizer translation, turnover, capacity, and covariance PSD checks; required artifacts are missing.
weakest_assumption: The package assumes a manual composite sign flip is not a PIT-C13 sign flip and can be accepted because it is economically narrated.
rebuttal_required: Remove the composite sign flip or provide a governance-approved C13 exception; absent that, this alpha must not graduate.
Recompute formal DSR without hardcoded signs and show DSR>=0.50, including method-shopping penalty and raw code output.
Provide challenge_note.md covering RF-A1~A7, measured sector-neutral IC, top-decile 20d TV>=2e8, and Usable_Date<=sig_date audit.
Provide weights.csv, risk_package/optimization_package, and covariance.parquet proving AX-007 paired multi-sleeve deployment and covariance PSD with condition number<=100.
